visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair and a white graphic t-shirt holds two red and black food packages toward the camera. She smiles broadly, her eyes squinting slightly with joy. The background consists of a sophisticated light-toned wallpaper with intricate grey floral and bird illustrations. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a white scalloped bowl containing dark, glazed pieces of meat. A pair of wooden chopsticks lifts a glossy, reddish-brown piece of meat, showing its moist texture and oily sheen under bright lighting. (3) Returning to the medium shot, the woman holds the bowl and uses chopsticks to eat. Her mouth moves in animated speech, and she occasionally uses her free hand to gesture for emphasis. Bright yellow variety captions appear at the bottom of the frame. (4) A close-up reveals a piece of beef tripe or tendon, heavily coated in a textured red sauce, held up by chopsticks. The camera remains static, focusing on the details of the food's spicy-looking coating. (5) The woman is shown again, tapping her cheek with one hand while holding a package, expressing satisfaction through facial expressions. (6) A final close-up shows a large white paper cup filled with instant noodles in a spicy red broth. Chopsticks swirl the noodles, which are topped with chunks of the previously shown glazed meat.
